# (:redis:test starts redis; Testcontainers starts its own helper, ryuk, beside any container).

#   <path>  <upstream image, pinned by digest>  <tag>

# The mirror is ghcr.io/kenstott/calcite/ci-hub/<path>:<tag>, copied from the digest given
# here. Testcontainers asks for these images by the tag written in the test code (or its own
# default), so with TESTCONTAINERS_HUB_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX=ghcr.io/kenstott/calcite/ci-hub/ it
# finds them in the mirror under the same path and tag. Only mirror-ci-images.yml writes
# those tags, and only from the digests listed here.

# ryuk   is testcontainers/ryuk:0.5.1 as pushed 2023-05-17 (the default of Testcontainers 1.19.3)
